summary.target: local production build (next start, port 3686) of the Next.js 16 frontend with live WordPress data
summary.scoring_note: The 'before' figure aggregates the seven agent findings with the seo-audit weights (Technical 22, Content 23, On-page 20, Schema 10, Performance 10, AI search 10, Images 5). The 'after' figure re-scores the same rubric with the frontend fixes verified by probes; it is an estimate, not a fresh agent run. The remaining gap is owned by WordPress/Yoast settings, editorial content, Cloudflare/DNS and field data that only exists after launch.
summary.business_type: Publisher / news portal (Malayalam-language Islamic portal, 22,297 articles)
top_findings: Category archive titles doubled the site name and tagline (fixed: cleanTitle in src/lib/seo.ts)
No ISR on any content route — every article, archive and WP page rendered per request (fixed: generateStaticParams + path-based pagination)
Yoast JSON-LD carried inLanguage en-GB, a second Organization identity, no dateModified, no ProfilePage.mainEntity (fixed: normalizeGraph at every depth)
page-sitemap.xml listed Elementor template pages that answer 500 from WordPress (fixed in the sitemap; the pages still need trashing in WordPress)
Archives had no crawlable pagination links; the scroll-loading list is invisible to crawlers (fixed: Previous/Next links in InfiniteFeed)
Meta descriptions truncated mid-sentence / in English / 'Title |' on older posts, Yoast archive template typos, admin-account bylines (WordPress editorial — pending)
quick_wins: Set WordPress Settings → General → Site Language to Malayalam
Fix 'compelete' / 'middile' in Yoast's archive description template
Decide the AI-crawler policy (GPTBot/ClaudeBot) — one-line change in src/app/robots.txt/route.ts
Connect YouTube and Instagram as Search Console platform properties

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt, 33 sitemap files at Yoast's exact paths with X-Robots-Tag: noindex, lowercase percent-encoding, 22,297/22,297 posts
Self-canonicals on the public host on every page type; real 404s; trailing-slash normalisation
ISR on articles, archives, WP pages and the authors directory (Cache-Control: s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate)
HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, CSP frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy

findings.title: Duplicate identical Location header on the first render of an app-level 308
findings.description: Next 16.3.0–16.3.4 replays the render's headers with appendHeader (next-server.js), so the first, uncached answer at a wrong-category article path or a short sub-category path carries the same Location twice. Cached answers carry it once. Identical duplicates are accepted by Chrome, Firefox and Googlebot; the static redirects in next.config are unaffected.
findings.recommendation: No app-level fix exists; documented in docs/MIGRATION.md §2. Re-check when upgrading Next.

findings.title: Pinch-zoom disabled by the viewport meta
findings.description: maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no fails WCAG 1.4.4 and Lighthouse's accessibility audit; the layout comment records it as a deliberate UX choice.
findings.recommendation: Publisher decision: remove the two directives in src/app/layout.tsx.

findings.title: Elementor template pages answer 500 from WordPress
findings.description: /elementor-122398/, /elementor-122411/, /elementor-119103/ are Elementor templates published as pages; WordPress's own REST render of them fails. The frontend no longer lists them in page-sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Trash them, or set them to noindex in Yoast.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Full Yoast graph republished per article; bylines linked to author pages; publish and (now) updated dates visible; visible breadcrumb; author bio in the author box; own h1 on the home page and the search page
Descriptions from the excerpt are trimmed on a sentence or word boundary when Yoast has nothing usable

findings.title: Yoast meta descriptions truncated mid-sentence, in English on Malayalam posts, or 'Title |' only
findings.description: 6 of 11 sampled pages; these are authored values passed through as-is (they are what Google has indexed).
findings.recommendation: Rewrite in Yoast per post; give the privacy policy a description about the policy.

findings.title: Yoast archive description template typos ('compelete', 'middile'); article titles carry the 61-character tagline
findings.description: Template text generated in WordPress; the frontend ignores the archive description and strips the doubled tagline from archive titles, but article titles still come from Yoast.
findings.recommendation: Fix the template in Yoast → Search Appearance; shorten the post title template.

findings.title: Articles bylined to the generic 'islamonlive' admin account; writers without bios
findings.description: E-E-A-T expertise signal; the author page h1 reads 'islamonlive' because that is the account's display name.
findings.recommendation: Reassign posts to real writers or give the staff account a proper name and bio; fill author bios in WordPress.

findings.title: No in-body subheadings; closing summaries in English only
findings.description: Analytical articles have zero H2/H3; the existing closing Summary is English-only and under the 134–167 word citation band.
findings.recommendation: Style-guide change: 2–3 H2s on analytical pieces, a 2–4 sentence Malayalam takeaway at the end, a linked source for historical claims.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Archive titles cleaned; page N titles and self-canonicals; og:url equals canonical; home OG/Twitter defaults; Search title carries the query; RSS autodiscovery; internal links normalised with trailing slashes; crawlable pagination

findings.title: Article titles 105–152 characters because of Yoast's tagline suffix
findings.description: Guaranteed SERP truncation; the frontend keeps Yoast's article titles as they are what ranks today.
findings.recommendation: Shorten the Yoast post title template.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: One WebSite and one Organization identity on every page (name, logo /logo.png 298×81, SearchAction /search/?q=, inLanguage ml at every depth)
dateModified on every Article/WebPage with a UTC offset; ProfilePage.mainEntity; AboutPage/ContactPage with mainEntity → Organization and the site nodes embedded
Organization sameAs (Facebook, X, YouTube, Instagram), foundingDate, address, email, parentOrganization

findings.title: Featured images below Google's 696 px guidance
findings.recommendation: Upload featured images at ≥1200 px; not a code defect.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0 and TBT good everywhere; desktop LCP 1.2–1.8 s; ISR on all content routes; AVIF offered; only 4 font files preloaded (the two reader faces are on demand); YouTube player is a click-to-play facade

findings.title: Lab mobile LCP 5–11 s on all five pages
findings.description: Local, no-CDN Lighthouse with mobile throttling. Home: third-party Instagram previews (~1.1 MB, signed URLs that cannot be resized) and the podcast artwork (880 KB, hot-linked); other pages: font weight (~470 KB).
findings.recommendation: Judge on Search Console field data after launch (Cloudflare + Vercel edge, Brotli). Route the podcast artwork through the media proxy; consider dropping a font family for phones.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Full SSR; news sitemap; robots.txt policy matches Content-Signal search=yes/ai-train=no; sameAs with YouTube/Instagram; inLanguage ml; dateModified; author bios; visible breadcrumbs; llms.txt (optional, ignored by Google)

findings.title: GPTBot and ClaudeBot blocked — also blocks ChatGPT search and Claude web results
findings.description: Reproduces the live site's Cloudflare list. OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot are open only by omission.
findings.recommendation: Publisher decision; one-line change in src/app/robots.txt/route.ts plus explicit Allow groups.

findings.title: Citability: no in-body headings, summaries under the 134–167 word band, English-only
findings.description: Highest-weighted GEO dimension; editorial habit rather than code.

categories.name: Images
what_works: next/image with srcset/sizes, lazy loading, AVIF/WebP; zero broken images at 375/768/1280; featured-image alt text from WordPress

findings.title: Decorative alt="" on card thumbnails and avatars beside their visible titles
findings.description: Correct accessibility practice for images adjacent to a text label (no double announcement); the audit counted them as missing alt text.
findings.recommendation: No change; keep descriptive alt on featured images (already the case).

findings.title: No 1200×630 default social image for old posts without a featured image
findings.recommendation: Provide the file; change the fallback in src/lib/seo.ts.
